items.quote: And Moses spake unto Aaron, Say unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, Come near before the LORD
items.claim: Moses spoke to Aaron and instructed him to tell the congregation of the children of Israel to come near before the LORD
items.object: Aaron; congregation of the children of Israel

items.quote: for he hath heard your murmurings
items.claim: The LORD heard the murmurings of the Israelites
